test_title: PYST 31: SSC CHSL 2023 - English (Held On: 11 Aug, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
**Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word from the following sentence.**

Allegation

The lawyer’s cross-examination tactics were designed to elicit incriminating testimony from the witness.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Testimony**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• An antonym is a word that has the opposite meaning of the given word.
 
• **Allegation **means a claim or assertion that someone has done something illegal or wrong. (यह दावा या दावा कि किसी ने कुछ अवैध या गलत किया है)
 
 
• **Example**: *The police are investigating the allegation of fraud against the company.*
 
 
 
• Marked option **Testimony **means evidence or a statement given by a witness under oath. (किसी गवाह द्वारा शपथ के तहत दिया गया साक्ष्य या बयान)
 
 
• **Example**: *During the trial, the witness provided crucial testimony that helped the jury reach a verdict.*
 
 
 
• Therefore, the antonym of allegation is testimony.

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Incriminating**: Providing evidence or suggesting involvement in a crime. (साक्ष्य प्रदान करना या किसी अपराध में शामिल होने का सुझाव देना)
 
• **Designed**: Planned or created with a specific purpose in mind. (किसी विशिष्ट उद्देश्य को ध्यान में रखकर योजना बनाई या बनाई गई)
 
• **Tactics**: Strategic actions or plans for achieving a specific goal. (किसी विशिष्ट लक्ष्य को प्राप्त करने के लिए रणनीतिक कार्य या योजनाएँ)
